about_the_game:
The Law Banned the Booze. They Didn’t Ban the Thirst.

It’s 1920. The government just turned every honest bartender into a criminal overnight. In Silent Spirits, you’re not just running a bar; you’re keeping a dying culture alive in the shadows. From the first drop of bathtub gin in 1919 to the final days of Prohibition in 1933, you’ll have to outsmart the law and satisfy the city’s dangerous appetite for illicit spirits.

Behind Closed Doors

Your storage is your sanctuary and your crime scene. Manage a hidden speakeasy where the elite and the desperate rub elbows. Keep the glasses full, and the customers happy—but remember: one loud patron or one loose lip is all it takes to bring the coppers to your door.

Distill, Brew, and Survive

Gather raw materials and master the art of the underground still. Whether it's rotgut moonshine or high-end whiskey, every bottle you produce is a gamble. As the years pass, unlock authentic recipes that demand better equipment and higher stakes. Quality keeps the customers coming back; quantity keeps the mafia off your back.

The Rhythm of the Underground

Life under the ban is a relentless cycle. Use the Daylight to cook your batches and prep the bar. When Evening falls, open the secret door and serve the thirsty masses. But the real work starts at Midnight: navigate the streets and dodge police patrols to make your deliveries. One wrong turn during a drop-off, and you’ll lose more than just your cargo.

Debt to the Syndicate

The Mafia provides the protection you need, but their "friendship" isn't free. Meet their annual quotas to stay in their good graces and earn rare recipes. Fail them, and you’ll find out that the police are the least of your worries.

15 Years of Prohibition History

Watch the world change through newspaper headlines and escalating tension. From the optimistic start of the "Noble Experiment" to the violent desperation of the early 30s, adapt to new laws, changing tastes, and a city that gets more dangerous with every passing year.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game features historical themes set during the 1920s Prohibition era in the United States. It includes references to alcohol production and distribution, as well as interactions with law enforcement and organized groups in a fictionalized setting.

No explicit violence or sexual content is present. All content is presented in a stylized, atmospheric, and narrative-driven manner inspired by the era.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 / AMD Radeon R7 250

short_description: Operate a speakeasy in 1920s Prohibition-era America in this business simulation. Craft illicit alcohol, serve demanding customers, and outmaneuver police patrols during high-stakes deliveries. Smuggle shipments to the mob and expand your underground empire across 15 years of escalating danger.
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
